newsitem.title: USA: Welch named executive director of Indiana agency.
newsitem.headline: Welch named executive director of Indiana agency.

text.p: - Robert Welch Jr. will become executive director of the Indiana Housing Finance Authority starting April 21, Indiana Lt. Gov. Joe Kernan announced Thursday.

Welch, the agency's current deputy director and chief financial officer, will replace Ira Peppercorn who plans to leave the agency on April 18 to join GE Capital Corp. in Washington, D.C. as vice president for business development, according to the announcement.
